lm_output: The passage describes a group of people who do not turn to the good, distrust, deceive, hunger for money, or itch for empty glory, as their treasure is in heaven and they refer all things to the glory of Christ. They also do not agree with others, including themselves, as the speaker points out that the person being addressed (Luther) contradicts himself in the same assertion, saying one thing at the beginning and something else later on. The speaker seems to be critical of Luther for this inconsistency and finds it off-putting.
